test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair of letter-clusters which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two sets of pair of letter-cluster given below. Both pairs of letter-clusters follow the same pattern.

HMQ : QMH

PWY : YWP
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ee962adf975fb30ba7325d19340940dbdbe3002d29e3d3bb1bc10d3a54112b8.png] ​

**Logic: Rearrangement of the given letters.**

**Given:**

HMQ : QMH →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a28d65e8c815ccedcdc519ac45f5b479433052836c59f4c47f438eb28caa43d6.png] 

PWY : YWP →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01c99124c07971a26296f6426c2a07c9f80b30e1994d3da130062f9cc375c1de.png] 

Checking all the given options:

**1.** QRT : RQT →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26fdb1124116e8015cbc1f6cfc90c1c5a844500d8f5c5267a403a1c6a34358e0.png] 

**2. **UWK : VXL →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f70fae6f14fb9f182032029ee87e3e46502dc25444cf4fb41b790be827015b0e.png] 

**3. **LJH : HJL →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/233f88ff24882bd76a997b3eed721a634751325f369e8a1b0873df249d0414f6.png] 

**4.** EJK : OPQ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11885d09c98c518bcdff6843d443e0c858d655a7951af091484dc58bbb78ef13.png] 

Here, **'LJH : HJL'** is similar to the given letter clusters.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
